_provenance.method: autodiff (jax.linearize) Jacobians of production forward.fold_mu; rows 1/sqrt(mu) over live cells; SVD-orthonormalization principal angles
_provenance.note: theta FD err 2e-6 is central-difference truncation at step 2e-3 (step scaled by max|theta|=2000 from the dead-bin sentinel), not autodiff error

exp4.note_sigma_fixed: sigma_N/sigma_z held at their HalfNormal prior scales (conditional Laplace)

pad_completeness_window.statement: sum_b(pad) theta-cols == sum_s psi_c[s, m0]/(1 - C[s, m0]) - sum(window theta-cols with b_to_cell == m0); m0 = molly cell 0 = [19.5, 20.0) into which ALL pad bins clip (b_to_cell)
pad_completeness_window.reading: a uniform pad rescale is EXACTLY a completeness offset in the bottom molly cell plus a compensating rescale of the 19.5-20.0 window bins; involves psi_c + window, NOT the FP; psi_c prior controls it

t_vs_lam_scale.reading: global FP scale is shared between exp(t) and lam_total; the t prior (sd 0.10-0.17) controls it
